sections.title: Appearance
lines: An oversized spotted hyena with a raised shoulder ridge, sloping back and broad jaws.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Bite · melee · +5 to hit · reach 5 ft. · 2d6 + 3 piercing

sections.title: Trait mechanics
lines: Cackling Chorus · Three or more hyenas within 30 ft. of one another form a chorus. A creature starting its turn within 10 ft. of a participating hyena makes a CON save or is deafened until the start of its next turn. The DC is 8 plus the number of participating hyenas.

sections.title: Bonus action mechanics
lines: Warning Yip · Choose a visible friendly hyena or gnoll within 30 ft. The next attack against it before the start of this hyena’s next turn has disadvantage.

sections.title: Reaction mechanics
lines: Rampage · When the hyena reduces a creature to 0 HP, it can move up to half its speed and Bite once. If it does, attacks against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 13 and Stealth 12. Use Stealth instead of rolling when the creature hides.
Printed ability modifiers are STR +3, DEX +2, CON +2, INT -4, WIS +1, CHA -2.
Encounter habitat suggestions draw on the equivalent animal in Monster Manual (2024).
Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, p. 360.

sections.title: Appearance
lines: A large, brightly marked frog with smooth skin and powerful folded hind legs.

sections.title: Senses
lines: darkvision 30 ft.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Bite · melee · +5 to hit · reach 5 ft. · 1d10 + 3 piercing plus 1d10 poison

sections.title: Trait mechanics
lines: Amphibious · Breathes air and water.
Standing Leap · Jumps up to 20 ft. horizontally or 10 ft. vertically, including from a standstill.
Toxic Skin · A creature that touches the frog, or hits it in melee from within 5 ft., must make a DC 13 CON save. On failure it is poisoned and mildly hallucinates until the end of its next turn.

sections.title: Action mechanics
lines: Bite · On a hit, the creature is grappled (escape DC 13) and restrained. The frog cannot Bite another target until the grapple ends.

Swallow · Bite one grappled target of Medium size or smaller. On a hit, swallow it and end the grapple. The frog can hold one swallowed creature. The victim is blinded and restrained, has total cover against outside effects, and takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of the frog’s turns. If the victim damages the frog, the frog makes a DC 11 CON save at the end of that turn. On failure it regurgitates the victim prone within 5 ft. If the frog dies, the victim can exit prone using 5 ft. of movement and is no longer restrained.

sections.title: Bonus action mechanics
lines: Reeling Tongue · Target one visible Large or smaller creature within 20 ft. DC 13 STR save or pull it up to 15 ft. closer.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 10 and Stealth 11. Use Stealth instead of rolling when the creature hides.
Printed ability modifiers are STR +3, DEX +1, CON +1, INT -4, WIS +0, CHA -4.
Encounter habitat suggestions draw on the equivalent animal in Monster Manual (2024).
The habitat suggestions use the ordinary Giant Frog as an ecological analogue. All encounter mechanics come from the poisonous form’s v0.2 block.
Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, p. 358.

lines: Bite · A creature hit must make a DC 13 CON save. On failure, the GM chooses Rat Plague or poisoning until the end of the target’s next turn. The short poisoning option is complete in v0.2.

Rat Plague (v0.1 supplement) · If using the earlier publisher sidebar, the victim is poisoned and regains HP only by magic until cured. Repeat this bite’s CON save every 24 hours.
